articles.headline: Five-Game Surge Lifts Everett zombies to #1 Amid Five-Way Logjam at 6-4
articles.body:
After starting the year in a dogfight, Everett zombies have rattled off five straight wins—capped by a 127.9–92.4 rout of Team Gmoney—to claim the #1 spot in the Week 10 Power Rankings (74.2 index). The win keeps Everett zombies atop a crowded five-team pileup at 6-4 alongside Northwest Jobbers, Dude Where's My Picture, H Dub Bosworths, and Team Gmoney.

Nothing is settled yet, though. Northwest Jobbers (6-4, W2) ground out a 103.4–96.1 win over Seaclowns, while Dude Where's My Picture (6-4, 1,011.9 PF) reminded the league of their ceiling with Week 10's highest score (143.2). With five teams at 6-4 and five more at 4-6, one bad Sunday could swing a roster from a first-round bye to the outside looking in.

articles.headline: William's Wild Team Outguns JBleezie in 253.4-Point Week 10 Shootout
articles.body:
In the highest-scoring clash of Week 10, William's Wild Team (131.2) and JBleezie (122.2) traded haymakers all weekend before William's Wild Team pulled away for a 9.1-point victory. The win snaps JBleezie into a two-game skid despite putting up the third-highest total of the week.

Elsewhere, drama came down to identical 7.3-point margins: Big Baller (95.5) survived Gretchen (88.2) to extend their hot streak to four straight wins, while Northwest Jobbers (103.4) held off Seaclowns (96.1) in a defensive grinder.

articles.headline: The Scoring Paradox: JBleezie Leads the League in Points—and Sits in 8th
articles.body:
If fantasy football rewarded pure firepower, JBleezie (1,050.4 PF) and H Dub Bosworths (1,025.9 PF) would be cruising into the playoffs. Instead, JBleezie sits at 4-6 in #8 after running into yet another 130-point buzzsaw, while H Dub Bosworths followed up a strong season-long scoring pace by laying an 82.1-point egg in a 61.2-point blowout loss to Dude Where's My Picture.

Meanwhile, Big Baller (4-6) owns the league's lowest season scoring total (947.0 PF) and second-worst Points Against (1,054.7 PA), yet somehow rides a four-game winning streak right back into the playoff hunt. Style points don't count in the standings—and right now, survival is everything.

roasts.text: H Dub Bosworths scored 82.1 points in Week 10 and lost by 61.2 to Dude Where's My Picture. That wasn't a fantasy matchup—that was a mercy-rule scrimmage.
JBleezie has scored a league-high 1,050.4 points this season and is somehow 4-6 in 8th place. At this point, even their bye week would probably drop 125 on them.
Big Baller has the fewest points in the entire league (947.0 PF) and has won four straight games anyway. Somebody check the commissioner's schedule generator.
Everett zombies (6-4, W5) just hung 127.9 on Team Gmoney to take #1 in the Power Rankings—and still found time to tweak the roster seven times on Tuesday.
